text:
mila: Quick postmortem follow-up. Pattern repeating: accept handshake timeouts -> truncated stream chunks -> client reconnect storms. Need clear owners, small PR-sized tasks and an exact canary window. Reply with what you can take.

rajesh: I can take the runtime telemetry + hypothesis (ITEM 1). Plan: add p95/p99 accept-queue depth, per-worker socket counts, and a little sampling hook for degraded handshakes. Will open a 1-2 page hypothesis note and a tiny logging PR. ETA Mon lunchtime.

cleo: I'll own SDK behavior (ITEM 2). Rubber meets road on backoff/jitter and client max-conns. I'll add exponential backoff with capped jitter to node/python sdks and a beta flag. Also expose a `stream.on('truncated')` event. ETA Wed EOD.

mila: Good. Who can own detection and alerting (dashboards + runbook)? Need a short triage doc for oncall.

rajesh: I'll add metrics to Grafana: `stream.accept.queue.p95`, `stream.accept.queue.p99`, `stream.partial_rate`. Wire alerts to #incidents with sensible thresholds. Also add a panel showing per-worker socket counts.

cleo: For SDKs, note: we only auto-retry if request declares `idempotent: true` and session-affinity can be preserved. Will include code snippet in the beta release notes. Example: ```js
const s = client.stream(req, { idempotent: true });
s.on('truncated', () => { // backoff + retry logic });
```

mila: Ops constraints: canaries must run outside 09:00-17:00 PST. Target window suggestion 01:00-05:00 UTC Friday. Agree?

rajesh: Agree. Canary sizing: start with 3 staging shards then 10% prod if stable. Rollback triggers: immediate rollback if partial_rate > 2x baseline OR overall 5xx rate increases > 0.4%.

cleo: Test plan: I'll build a micro-harness that simulates chunk truncation, abrupt socket close, and delayed final EOS. Need eng-infra to provision a 4-shard sandbox for a short pressure run.

ops-bot: INF ticket required: INF-5137 created for harness quota (requested shards=4, qps=1200, duration=2h).

mila: Nice. Timeline recap: metrics + small logs by Mon, SDK beta by Wed, harness Thu, canary Fri 01:00-05:00 UTC, full rollout next Tue if canary is green.

rajesh: I'll add short sampling traces for 200 failed handshakes so we can inspect stack traces and socket stats. Also will capture kernel SO_ACCEPT_QUEUE metrics.

cleo: I'll publish SDK beta with `beta/0.5.0` tag and include migration notes. Also add `stream.truncated` event and recommend client-side capped backoff.

mila: Runbook owner is me. I'll draft "If truncated streams spike" with queries, alert thresholds, and quick rollback steps (toggle flag, remove canary). Posting draft by Tue.

rajesh: I'll attach dashboards and link them in the runbook.

cleo: ack.

ops-bot: Canary job scheduled: `trunc-detect-canary-v1` -> 3456790000 targeting staging-1..4.

mila: Closing: weekly check-ins Fridays 09:00 PT until we confirm stability. I'll update the postmortem doc with the owner table and timelines. Also will loop in product to ensure Redwood Optimize has an eval to detect regressions introduced by retries.

rajesh: ack.

cleo: ack.

mila: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
